body.title: Video Creator (100% remote)
body.description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no social following required!

Hello! We’d love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Spirit Halloween, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
body.location: USA, Canada, Ireland or UK only

body.title: Senior AI Engineer / Architect
body.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for senior AI engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from [75+] countries

Who we’re looking for

AI Engineer:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience applying AI to practical technology solutions
  • A solid understanding of Python is a must; experience with other programming languages commonly used in AI is a plus
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Pinecone or Weaviate is required
  • 2+ years of experience with LangChain is mandatory
  • 2+ years of experience with large language models (LLMs) or vLLMs is mandatory
  • 2+ years of experience with RAG or OpenAI is required

AI Agent Architect:

  • 3+ years of experience with Python
  • 3+ years of experience with LLM
  • Experience with Multi-agent systems architecture, AI agent orchestration, AI telemetry is a must.

AI Automation Architect:

  • 1+ year of experience with Workflow Automation and Webhooks
  • 3+ years with SQL is a must
  • Familiarity with AI API integration and Claude Cowork is a must
  • Knowledge of Make.com/n8n/Zapier

 

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production
  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)
  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls
  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision
  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

 

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile
  2. Verify your role
  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the Lemon.io community.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & An gular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

 

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

body.title: Language specialist
body.description:
Remote Language Projects – Native & Fluent Speakers

Remote | Independent Contractor 

iMerit, an EXL Company, is looking for native or fluent speakers of Burmese, Persian, Khmer, Maltese, and Slovenian for upcoming remote language projects.

How to Apply

Complete the short form and select only the language you are proficient in and wish to be assessed for. Our team will review your submission and share the relevant application link for that language.

Please apply only for languages in which you have native or fluent proficiency.

Project opportunities are subject to availability and successful completion of the applicable assessment.
